readme.txt.content:
Round-two research reproduction snapshot.

No weights, credentials, private raw logs or connection details are included.
Use catalog.json to distinguish QVAC addon runs from upstream CLI experiments and rejected results.
For native inputs, use packages/diffusion-cpp/scripts/inference-benchmark.js on the stated feature branch.
Edit checkpoint and backend paths relative to the JSON directory; verify checkpoint SHA256 first.
Run: bare scripts/inference-benchmark.js <input.json> <new-output-directory>
Mask the authorized physical GPU externally; cuda0 denotes its logical index.
Set only the process environment listed for that experiment; do not change host configuration.
Native repetition counts match the collected screens/confirmations. One warmup is excluded per prompt.
Upstream CLI inputs launch fresh processes. Generation log time is separate from process wall time.
See h3-isolated-fusions.json for source, ggml, CUTLASS and build identities and patch application.
A passing or faster upstream run is not a validated upgrade for QVAC. Preserve custom QVAC behavior.
Quality values compare same-host outputs; different hardware Flux containers and cross-runtime math are not equivalent.
Never multiply independent nominal speedups; use directly measured combinations in the report.
